scenario: adviceprobe returns a catalogued file whose hash is in no evaluated arm; media.json lists one item whose fingerprint matches an accepted baseline receipt and one whose fingerprint matches nothing.
notes: D8: an item whose fingerprint equals an accepted receipt's fingerprint on that arm is evidence with strength supplied-media; anything else is unassessedMedia with the reason and is not evidence.

D8 (media item schema 2): the accepted item is copied to media/<sha256[:12]>-<basename> and its row carries every item field plus id, sha256, bytes; a rejected item is unassessed by ONE closed reason (here fingerprint-mismatch), never a free sentence alone.

A-3: an arm's comparison set is its OWN configuration (accepted receipts with part null or arm). A baseline-order picture declared for the candidate arm with the baseline fingerprint is fingerprint-mismatch even though the candidate's reverse receipt consumed that order.
An item with no provenance object naming tool and capturedUtc is provenance-missing (checked after the fingerprint source, before the arm's receipts), never accepted with provenance null.
